# GTA 6 Heist Guide & Leonida Syndicate Database

> Independent strategy intelligence hub, interactive heist payout calculators, live weekly meta trackers, co-op LFG squad finder, and copyright-safe walkthroughs for Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) across Vice City and the State of Leonida.

## Core Tools & Community
- [Home & High-Value Target Directory](https://www.gta6heistguide.com/index.html): Overview of Leonida heist vaults, live weekly 1.5X rotation, and interactive trailer/ad generator.
- [Interactive Heist Planner & Cut Calculator](https://www.gta6heistguide.com/heist-planner.html): Bookmarkable, URL-shareable 1–4 player payout optimizer and vault keypad decryption mini-game.
- [Live GTA 6 Intel, Weekly Meta & Legal Rules](https://www.gta6heistguide.com/live-intel.html): Auto-updating weekly Thursday rotation, live gaming press breakdowns, and Take-Two DMCA-safe editorial rules.
- [Interactive Leonida Radar Map](https://www.gta6heistguide.com/interactive-map.html): Clickable GPS vault pins across Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, and Mount Kalaga National Park.
- [Heist Crew Lounge & Co-Op LFG Matchmaker](https://www.gta6heistguide.com/forum.html): Real-time D1-backed player forum and PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X|S, and PC friend finder.
